content.text: In regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-explained-digital-creators-3|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms like Stripe are unavailable, digital creators face significant hurdles in monetizing their work. Countries like Nigeria and Venezuela have seen conventional payment methods crumble under regulatory pressures and economic instability. COREMERCH provides a solution through Stack 02, enabling you to set up a fully operational crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, avoiding the pitfalls of traditional payment gateways. This guide walks you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-until-you-2|Do Not]]ing-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-works-how-22|building]] a robust crypto store using Cloudflare Pages, ensuring your products are delivered seamlessly and payments are processed efficiently without any reliance on external platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment systems often fail in markets facing economic challenges. COREMERCH’s infrastructure is designed to empower creators by providing them with full ownership of their online store. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages, you bypass the limitations imposed by conventional payment processors. With automatic crypto payment processing via NOWPayments, you ensure your income is not subject to the whims of unstable markets or regulatory constraints. This architecture is built to withstand the pressures that often cripple standard digital commerce solutions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, you’ll need a few essential components. First, ensure you have a Cloudflare account to access Pages and Workers. Second, create a Supabase account to manage your database and store order information securely. You will also need a NOWPayments account for handling cryptocurrency transactions. Prepare your digital products, such as ebooks or courses, and have them ready for upload. With these components in place, you are equipped to build a seamless online store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your backend on Cloudflare Workers, which handles the logic for payment processing and order management. Next, configure NOWPayments, integrating it with your Cloudflare setup to enable automatic payment verification. Ensure your products are stored in Supabase, allowing for easy access and retrieval. Use the delivery methods provided by Cloudflare to serve your products directly to customers after successful payment. This streamlined pipeline guarantees that every transaction is handled efficiently, minimizing delays and maximizing user satisfaction.
Own your infrastructure, don’t rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it’s time to go live. Conduct thorough testing to ensure that payments are processed correctly and that products are delivered seamlessly. Test your payment processing on mainnet to confirm everything operates as intended. After confirming your setup, promote your store to your audience. Share your shop URL, https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, on social media and other platforms to attract customers. Monitor your transactions closely to address any issues promptly as you start processing your first sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing your crypto store, consider how you can scale your operations. Leverage the features of Supabase to analyze your sales data and customer interactions. Expand your product offerings by adding new digital goods to your store. You can also enhance your marketing efforts to reach a broader audience. If you encounter increased demand, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) can further optimize your deployment, providing advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for improved email deliverability and security.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by setting up Cloudflare Pages and integrating NOWPayments for payment processing. Use Supabase to store orders and manage your product catalog. This combination allows you to create a fully functional online store without the need for traditional payment platforms.
No KYC, no buyer accounts, just seamless transactions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
What platforms can I use to host my digital store?

You can use Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages to host your digital store. Both platforms provide the infrastructure needed for deploying your online store without relying on conventional payment processors.
How does Stack 02 differ from Stack 01?

Stack 02, deployed via Cloudflare Pages, offers enhanced capabilities such as more products, comprehensive testing, and better scalability. In contrast, Stack 01 focuses on a simpler implementation with GitHub Pages.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it a cost-effective solution for processing cryptocurrency payments without the need for KYC or buyer accounts.
Can I sell physical products using this setup?
While this setup is optimized for digital products, you could adapt it for physical products by implementing order fulfillment processes separately, ensuring you manage logistics effectively.
How secure is this infrastructure for financial transactions?
This infrastructure is secure, relying on established tools like Cloudflare and NOWPayments to ensure that your transactions are processed safely, with your data ownership guaranteed.
